title: Every worklog entry on a fetched issue and its subtasks
description: Time is logged on the subtask people are working on, so a story's own time is routinely empty while its subtasks carry every hour. This file merges the parent and every subtask, and `entries` must hold `total` rows.

key.description: The issue this file was fetched for.

readOnly.description: Worklog entries are created in Jira, never by editing this file.

scope.description: Whether subtask time was merged in.

total.description: How many entries were found across every issue read. `entries` must hold this many.

totalSeconds.description: Time logged, in seconds. Both breakdowns below must sum to this.

entries.description: Oldest first, so the table reads as the history of the work.

issueKey.description: The issue the time was logged against, usually a subtask rather than the fetched issue.

timeSpent.description: Jira's own duration format: 2h, 30m, 1d 4h. A day is 8 hours.

byPerson.description: Totals per person. Sums to totalSeconds; a mismatch means a parse or fetch bug.

byIssue.description: Totals per issue. Written only when more than one issue carries time. Sums to totalSeconds.

sources.description: Every issue read for this file, each with the count Jira reported, so a truncated read is provable after the fact.
